stem:
The proton NMR spectrum of compound **E** in the solvent $\text{CDCl}_3$ is shown. The molecular formula of compound **E** is $\text{C}_9\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_2$.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain why $\text{CDCl}_3$ is used as a solvent instead of $\text{CHCl}_3$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain why TMS is added to give the small peak at chemical shift $\delta = 0$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Compound **E** is hydrolysed by hot $\text{NaOH(aq)}$, giving two organic products only. One of these products is ethanol.

Name the functional group in compound **E** that is hydrolysed by hot $\text{NaOH(aq)}$.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Describe and explain the splitting patterns of the peaks at $\delta = 1.4$ and $\delta = 4.3$.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
Each molecule of compound **E** contains five protons which give rise to the peaks between $\delta = 7.0$ and $\delta = 8.5$.

Identify the functional group in compound **E** which contains these protons.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Give the structural formula of compound **E**.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
The mass spectrum of compound **E** includes fragment ions with $m/e$ values of 29 and 77.

Give the formulae of these fragment ions.
